scope: AAA-022 task scope: bounded prepublication persistence pages, explicit page-size Config, synchronous live-writer handoff, and ambiguous append recovery

criteria.description: Confirmed A03 migration authority and the approved A18 W2 design authorize this exact A20 owner scope, including the agent-loop page writer and required documentation. No external repository action is included.
criteria.limitations: The generated config catalog remains in its existing active owner record; this gate does not add or change customization-policy ownership.

criteria.description: A20 uses a validated positive safe-integer page size with a finite maximum; appends baseline and setup events in bounded pages; advances the cursor only after append resolution; drains to a fixed Session sequence cut; and invokes publication synchronously after the final cancellation and equality check. A rejected page is ambiguous and is reconciled only by explicit resume from the backend actual log.
criteria.limitations: Default 128 and maximum 4096 bound event count per append call; neither value claims an optimal throughput point or caps bytes.

criteria.description: The exact 15-path gate requires falsifying tests for bounded page count, events added during an in-flight append, synchronous publication handoff, cancellation, partial-effect rejection followed by exact-id explicit resume, and no automatic retry or create-to-resume switch. It also requires paired agent-loop, architecture, and persistence documentation plus generated bilingual config catalog updates and focused checks.
criteria.limitations: The gate defines required acceptance before implementation; it does not claim those implementation tests or documentation updates have already passed.

fingerprint_scope.hash_rule: Sort relative paths; for each existing input hash path, NUL, working-tree bytes, NUL.

authority.scope: AAA-022 task scope: bounded prepublication persistence pages, explicit page-size Config, synchronous live-writer handoff, and ambiguous append recovery
authority.decision: Apply the user-authorized REM-028 W0-W4 migration scope and A18-approved W2 design to A20: implement bounded prepublication persistence pages, explicit validated page sizing, fixed-cut draining with synchronous publication handoff, and explicit recovery from the backend’s actual persisted log. This authorizes only the exact A20 paths and local verification; it does not authorize external repository actions.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate if A20 changes runtime/API behavior beyond the bounded Session migration, alters Session data or model-visible input, changes dependencies, touches a path outside the 15-path scope, or needs an external repository action.

next_action: Implement the bounded page writer and explicit page-size Config, prove fixed-cut synchronous handoff and ambiguous failure recovery, then update paired documentation and generated config catalogs within this exact 15-path scope.
revalidation_triggers: The configured append page exceeds the positive safe-integer range or configured maximum.
An event appended while an earlier page awaits append is missed, duplicated, reordered, or published before persistence acceptance.
The final cursor equality check and PreparedAgent.publish call can be separated by an await, callback, or yield.
A rejected append is retried or create automatically switches to resume without an explicit caller action.
Any changed path falls outside the exact 15-path fingerprint scope or changes released Session data, model-visible input, or SDK output.

revalidation.reason: A19 is complete; A20 is the next independently gated action within the same stable AAA-022 backlog task.
